title: I Watched Our Interns Play Valorant for Three Hours. Put Your Rank on the Resume.
why_read: An anecdotal opinion piece about esports experience as a team-building signal, with no technical content relevant to software engineering practice.
analysis: This is a personal essay arguing that competitive gaming rank reflects valuable soft skills (communication, coaching, resilience) and should be listed on resumes, framed around watching interns play Valorant. It contains no code, architecture, or technical methodology and is fundamentally a career/culture opinion piece rather than an engineering article. It may be mildly engaging as a read but offers essentially nothing for a technical digest focused on substantive engineering content.
